title: TPC-H Q1 — MongoDB embedding versus PostgreSQL reproducibility audit
conference: XVIII Brazilian e-Science Workshop (BreSci 2024), co-located with SBBD
scope: Portable audit of Q1 from the published repository, using genuine TPC-H dbgen 2.13.0 at scale factor 0.01 (complete generated lineitem table). The original MongoDB pipeline filters through 1998-12-01 while the original PostgreSQL query filters through 1998-09-02. Run both unchanged, then an explicitly named aligned variant that changes only MongoDB’s cutoff to 1998-09-02. Execute each engine/mode with and without an index in isolated database instances. Validate numerical equivalence only for aligned semantics and record original-source disagreement. This is a Q1 audit, not reproduction of all 22 queries, the paper’s hardware, scale or performance ranking. Timings under concurrent execution are observations, not a controlled database benchmark. Original data generator and specification: https://www.tpc.org/tpch/ and https://github.com/electrum/tpch-dbgen/tree/32f1c1b92d1664dba542e927d23d86ffa57aa253. TPC-H data are generated by definition; no hand-built fixture replaces them. Original code authors retain attribution; upstream has no explicit license declaration. MongoDB binary is obtained from its official distribution; respective upstream terms apply.
executionClaim: Adapted scientific workflow; completion and agreement are reported only by measured evidence.
